content:
maya: Heads up — new onboarding sampleapp is generating a ton of duplicate request IDs in logs when retries happen.
ryan: repro steps?
maya: run sampleapp with DEBUG_TELEMETRY=1 and hit /api/complete with transient 503s from the mock service. you'll see the same reqid repeated across retry attempts.
devon: hmm is this about reusing the same Retry-Id header or our reqid injection hook?
maya: looks like our reqid middleware runs before the retry library attaches retry metadata, so the reqid gets copied into retry headers and then re-emitted. logs: `reqid=abc123 attempt=1` then `reqid=abc123 attempt=2` (same id).
alex: can you paste a short log excerpt?
maya: sure:
```
INFO  sampleapp server started
DEBUG telemetry reqid=abc123 span=span-7 msg="incoming request"
WARN  http client retry reqid=abc123 attempt=1 status=503
WARN  http client retry reqid=abc123 attempt=2 status=503
ERROR sampleapp reqid=abc123 final-error="upstream 503"
```
ryan: that makes sense. we expect a fresh reqid per incoming request but different child attempts should get an attempt_id or at least annotate attempt.
ingrid: also noticed redaction edge: when DEBUG_TELEMETRY=1 we log headers before our redaction hook runs, so auth tokens leak in debug mode.
devon: oh no. so ordering issue again — otel hook order + redaction hook order.
maya: exactly. Onboarding team hit this while demoing to a new user and saw Authorization headers in stdout. bad first impression.
alex: proposed quick fixes: (1) move our redaction hook earlier in the chain, (2) change retry lib integration to produce a retry_id header instead of reusing reqid, (3) add a debug flag that scrub logs even in debug mode.
ryan: I like (2) and (1). (3) is fine but might be surprising for devs who expect full debug dumps.
devon: I'll prototype a middleware reorder in node express:
```
// apply redaction early
app.use(redactHeaders)
// reqid middleware
app.use(reqIdMiddleware)
// attach otel hooks
app.use(otelExpressMiddleware)
// http client wrapper that sets retry-id
httpClient.on('request', (req) => {
  req.headers['x-retry-id'] = uuid() // new id per attempt
})
```
devon: that removes reqid bleed across attempts. also add a small test that simulates 3 retries and asserts unique x-retry-id values.
ingrid: for onboarding docs we should add a WARNING about enabling DEBUG_TELEMETRY in public demos and link to how to enable scrubbed debug: `REDACT_IN_DEBUG=true`.
maya: can someone own the patch and a short changelog entry?
ryan: i'll take the express/node patch (will open PR in ~1h).
devon: i'll do a quick python client fix and add tests.
alex: I'll update docs + add a note to the sampleapp quickstart.
ingrid: telemetry-bot: please run an integration check when PRs are merged. :slightly_smiling_face:
telemetry-bot: Integration check queued for branch "telemetry/reqid-reorder" — CI job 4482 started.
maya: thanks all. once we ship, let's follow up with a small post in #all-hands about the onboarding demo guidance. :thumbsup:
ryan: SGTM
